item.text: {"actions":[{"action":"Record handoffs in an append-only history","mechanism":"Structured records replace scattered chat messages while preserving earlier entries and corrections.","implementation":"For each handoff, save sender, recipient, handoff time, submission time, and status. Restrict participants to the two existing volunteers; corrections reference earlier records.","check":"Record two handoffs and correct one timestamp. Verify both originals remain visible and the corrected time is clearly identified.","risk":"Entered handoff times depend on volunteer accuracy."},{"action":"Require the recipient to confirm receipt","mechanism":"Separate intended transfers from acknowledged possession so an offer never silently changes the holder.","implementation":"Create a pending handoff when the sender offers the key. On receipt, the other volunteer confirms and records the actual handoff time.","check":"Offer a transfer without confirming it. Verify the last confirmed holder remains labeled and the handoff stays unresolved until receipt.","risk":"Forgotten confirmations leave physical possession uncertain."},{"action":"Show one authoritative key-status card","mechanism":"A stable summary exposes possession and outstanding transfers without requiring volunteers to reconstruct the conversation.","implementation":"Pin a shared status view showing last confirmed holder, confirmation time, and every unresolved handoff. Label pending transfers prominently rather than implying certain possession.","check":"After confirmed, pending, and disputed transfers, verify the card matches the records and identifies unresolved items without opening chat history.","risk":"A stale cached view can mislead readers."},{"action":"Reject conflicting or repeated transfer submissions","mechanism":"Version checks and unique request identifiers prevent concurrent edits and retries from corrupting custody state.","implementation":"Accept a transfer only against the latest record version; allow one active transfer. Treat retries with the same identifier as the original submission.","check":"Submit conflicting transfers simultaneously, then repeat one request. Verify only one transfer exists and the rejected volunteer receives the current state.","risk":"Offline submissions may require review before acceptance."},{"action":"Provide an explicit possession-dispute workflow","mechanism":"Represent uncertainty directly instead of choosing whichever volunteer edited the record most recently.","implementation":"Let either volunteer flag incorrect possession. Preserve the last confirmed holder; show current possession as disputed. Resolve through both volunteers acknowledging a correction and its effective time.","check":"Submit contradictory possession reports. Verify uncertainty remains visible until both acknowledge a resolution and the original reports remain inspectable.","risk":"Resolution stalls when either volunteer is unavailable."},{"action":"Remind volunteers about unfinished handoffs","mechanism":"Age-based prompts surface forgotten confirmations without treating elapsed time as evidence that the key moved.","implementation":"Let the two volunteers choose a reminder interval. Prompt both when a handoff remains pending; offer confirm receipt, cancel an uncompleted transfer, or dispute.","check":"Leave a test handoff pending beyond the interval. Verify a reminder appears, ownership remains unchanged, and resolution stops further reminders.","risk":"Frequent reminders may be ignored or muted."}],"abstention_reason":""}
